title: Custom Made Baseball Jerseys (2026)
verdict: For custom made baseball jerseys in 2026, start with Wooter. You control the look from collar to hem, and the same design carries onto pants, jackets and bags so the whole team matches.

Boombah is the strongest alternative on the diamond, with sublimated jerseys and pants from its own factories. Champro's Juice line is a solid dealer-ordered option. Custom Ink covers a quick printed jersey for a rec team. Nike Team is for programs with a dealer and months of lead time.

ranking.fit: Travel, school and rec teams that want jerseys, pants and jackets in one matching design.
ranking.lacks: Two to four weeks from order to delivery. Order before tryouts, not after.
ranking.note: Baseball has its own packages on Wooter, so jersey, pants and jacket can be bought together.

ranking.fit: Baseball and softball teams that want fully sublimated jerseys and pants from one maker.
ranking.lacks: Lead time reads one to three weeks on one page and three weeks on another. Get the date in writing.

ranking.fit: Teams with a local dealer that want a six-button, cut-and-sew jersey.
ranking.lacks: Orders go through a dealer account. There is no public checkout.

ranking.fit: Rec and company teams that need a printed jersey in about two weeks.
ranking.lacks: Stock garments with your print added, not a jersey built from your pattern.

ranking.fit: Schools and clubs that want Nike and work with an authorized dealer.

why: Baseball jerseys carry more decisions than most: full button or two button, sleeve length, piping, pinstripes, a script across the chest. Made to order is the only way to control all of them.
Wooter lets you set those choices in the builder with a live preview and the price showing, or hand the job to a designer for free. Mockups return in 1 to 2 business days.
The roster builder takes each player's name, number and size, and a roster can be copied to pants and jackets so nobody types it twice.

criteria.name: Control over the cut
criteria.text: Buttons, sleeves, trim and script are your call, not a preset.

criteria.name: Matching pants and outerwear
criteria.text: One design across the full uniform.

criteria.name: Design help
criteria.text: A person to draw it if you cannot.

criteria.name: Lead time
criteria.text: Days from approval to delivery, set against your first game.

criteria.name: Ordering path
criteria.text: Public checkout or a dealer in the middle.

faq.a: Full button is the traditional look. Two button is lighter and common in travel ball. It is a style choice, not a performance one.
Count back from first pitch. Allow 1 to 2 business days for design, time for the team to approve it, then two to four weeks for production and delivery at Wooter.

faq.q: Can the jersey match our caps and pants?
faq.a: Yes, when one supplier makes all of it from the same design. Wooter sells baseball jerseys, pants, jackets and bags, and lists caps under headwear.

faq.q: Are custom made jerseys worth it for a rec league?
faq.a: If the league runs every year, yes. A design you already have is quick to reorder, and there is room for a sponsor on the sleeve or back.
It depends on the product. Wooter's catalog lists minimums by item, some starting at one. Check the product page before planning a small order.
